headline.zh: 青山周平设计的江景观景平台

traits.zh: 二楼Park空间可远眺黄浦江一线江景
traits.en: Second-floor Park space offers direct views of the Huangpu River

traits.zh: 空间由建筑师青山周平打造，含Gallery、Theater、Park三个主题区域
traits.en: Designed by architect Arata Isozaki, with Gallery, Theater, and Park zones

traits.zh: Gallery以艺术品方式陈列全球咖啡豆，主打哥伦比亚单一产区手冲系列
traits.en: Gallery displays global coffee beans as art; current focus: Colombian single-origin hand-drip series

traits.zh: 提供粉色奶昔、冰咖啡和巧克力甜点
traits.en: Serves pink milkshake, iced coffee, and chocolate dessert

focus.zh: 有开放观景平台但非专注办公空间
focus.en: Open viewing area, not optimized for focus

linger.zh: 二楼Park为开放式观景平台，适合久坐

adventure.zh: 本季主打五款SOE手冲，展现不同处理法风味
adventure.en: Five SOE hand-drip coffees with varied processing methods
